name: Omni Barton Creek Resort & Spa
positioning: Texas Hill Country golf and spa resort on 4,000 wooded acres just outside downtown Austin, with four championship golf courses and Mokara Spa
best_for: Golfers who want four championship courses on site
Spa-goers looking for Mokara Spa's pool deck, sauna and cold plunge
Families wanting resort activities with Austin's live music scene nearby

facts.text: The resort is just outside downtown Austin, on 4,000 wooded acres in the Texas Hill Country.
Austin-Bergstrom International Airport is about 18 miles, or about 30 minutes, away.
The resort has four championship golf courses.
The resort offers 72 holes of golf.
The resort has full-sized tennis courts and a fitness center with Peloton bikes.
Deluxe rooms have eclectic decor reminiscent of Hill Country style.
Guest rooms have warm touches of Southern decor and open up to the evergreen hills around the property.
There are nine dining outlets: six full-service restaurants, a lobby bar, a coffee shop and a pool bar.
Dining ranges from fresh seafood and classic steakhouse fare to sunset cocktails with Hill Country views.
The resort offers family-friendly activities and seasonal events.
The resort was a Conde Nast Traveler Readers' Choice Award winner in 2026.
Guests can head into Austin, the Live Music Capital of the World, for nightlife.

highlights.text: Mokara Spa guests have access to spa amenities including a private pool deck, a sauna and a cold plunge.
Mokara Spa is inspired by the area's creeks and springs.
Suites come in one- or two-bedroom layouts with floor-to-ceiling windows.
The outdoor pools are immersed in views of the Texas Hills.
The resort has a self-guided nature trail.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort location means guests need transportation to reach downtown Austin.
Overnight valet parking carries a nightly charge.
The resort is pet friendly for animals under 60 pounds, with a one-time non-refundable pet fee.
